# Build on Monark

For developers: connect your own code to a Monark instance, or extend Monark itself. New to the codebase? Start with [Set up a development environment](/docs/get-started/set-up-a-development-environment).

- [Public API](/docs/build/public-api): read and write your organization's data models and records over REST with an API key.
- [Webhooks](/docs/build/webhooks): receive Monark's event deliveries in your own service and verify them.
- [Agents and MCP](/docs/build/agents-and-mcp): give an AI agent or OpenAPI tool access, limited to what its key can do.
- [Extend Monark](/docs/build/extend): add modules, permissions, events, notifications, flags, schema, tests, search sources, automation nodes, API endpoints and assistant tools.
